name: notes agent flow over MCP
task: The same notes task an MCP host would run: initialize, search, hit a validation failure as a tool error, then create a note — every step a tools/call against /mcp. The note it creates shares the "Purge target" prefix that notes.eval.json purges, which is how it cleans up: destructive capabilities are never projected as MCP tools, so a purge step cannot run on this transport.

input.title: Purge target (created over MCP)
input.body: Created by pracht eval over tools/call.
